northStar.customerReaction: The first reaction should be: this looks exceptionally expensive, intentional and high-effort; then the reachable price should feel surprisingly good rather than cheap.
northStar.productPromise: Premium-feeling, highly tailored websites for small businesses, built on a reusable production system so quality can stay high without custom-agency overhead on every project.
northStar.qualityBar: Strong hero, high-quality imagery, short clear information, smooth/cinematic interaction, excellent mobile execution and no obvious template feel.
northStar.perceivedValuePrinciple: The front end should feel bespoke and high-budget even when roughly 70% of the underlying system is reusable.

priorityOrder: P0 · Finish Joey's own Agency Showroom as the visual and commercial proof layer.
P0 · Finish three visibly different example websites and surface them inside the agency site.
P0 · Use the remaining Higgsfield Unlimited window for assets that directly improve the agency site or those three examples.
P0 · Create at least one credible product/ad motion example and keep it clearly labelled as a demo until a real case exists.
P0 · After own site + three strong examples are showable, expose the offer to a real person before building a fourth fictional demo.

Premium Plumbing remains showcase 01 and the first commercial customer-template system.
Architectural Luxury remains a cinematic/storytelling showcase world.

successDefinition: Joey's own agency website stands as one coherent premium experience.
Three example websites are presentation-ready enough to show inside the agency site.
At least one ad/product-motion example exists.
Highest-value remaining Unlimited assets are harvested and organized for real use rather than quantity alone.
At least one real person sees the offer or a real external test project begins once the site and three examples are ready.
weekSprint.unlimitedWindow: Joey estimates roughly four days remain in the current Unlimited period; exact subscription timing should be verified manually in Higgsfield if needed.
weekSprint.antiDelayRule: After the own site plus three examples are good enough to show, do not build a fourth fictional demo before at least one real external viewer/test.

lockedDecisions.websiteVenturesPriority: Website selling is the primary near-term income engine.
lockedDecisions.agencyFirst: Joey's own Website Ventures / agency site sets the visual and technical ceiling before broad selling.
lockedDecisions.agencyFeel: Maximum-premium, calm, cinematic and highly intentional; Apple-like interaction discipline and Porsche-like polish are quality references, not branding references.
lockedDecisions.agencyRole: The agency site is showroom, offer explainer and R&D proof in one experience.
lockedDecisions.firstCommercialNiche: Plumbing/trades remains the first commercial showcase and customer-template system.
lockedDecisions.templateRule: Aim for roughly 70% reusable underlying structure while front-end identity, color, copy, hero, motion, composition and information rhythm can vary strongly by customer.
lockedDecisions.customerChoiceModel: The product can be configured through five main dimensions: visual theme, hero direction, scroll/motion family, information/story flow and optional functionality/integrations.
lockedDecisions.motionLibraryRule: Start with 3-4 strong motion families and grow toward a broader menu only after real customers reveal what gets chosen; do not prebuild ten fully polished motions just to fill a menu.
lockedDecisions.bespokeRule: Paid bespoke work is allowed outside the core system when the economics justify it; productization should primarily control revision/scope chaos rather than suppress creative variation.
lockedDecisions.mobileRule: Every important visual/interaction needs deliberate mobile behavior.
lockedDecisions.proofIntegrity: No fake reviews, projects, certifications, staff identity or performance claims.
lockedDecisions.higgsfieldRule: Prefer manual Unlimited exploration while available; preserve winners, generation metadata and direct page use.
lockedDecisions.qualityOverQuantity: A smaller curated set of genuinely usable high-quality assets is more valuable than thousands of mediocre generations.
lockedDecisions.salesGate: Own site + three strong examples is the trigger for real external feedback; perfection beyond that point cannot substitute for market evidence.

flow: Device lifts and becomes a real interface to coded examples.
Three distinct website showcase worlds plus Join the Club / Coming Soon.
Open-field visual transition into ads/product motion capability.
Interactive Thuisbezorgd-like website configurator with visible option pricing.
Optional intro/call CTA; never block the ending behind a booking action.
Closing sequence returns the device visually to the same stone.
agencyExperience.guideCharacter: A subtle generic maker-guide placeholder exists in v1.5. An actual Joey-like character remains optional future polish and should not become gimmicky or be represented as Joey's likeness without a proper reference image.

workingCommercialHypotheses.foundingPrice: €995 setup ex VAT + €49/month is the current active test hypothesis for the core offer; not a permanent ceiling or market fact.
workingCommercialHypotheses.baseScope: Up to 3 core pages, responsive desktop/mobile, contact flow and basic technical SEO/analytics, with one bundled revision round as the current working scope.
workingCommercialHypotheses.pricingCaveat: Add-on prices in Agency v1.5 are interface/test hypotheses for learning; they are not locked until real delivery time, demand and willingness-to-pay evidence exists.
workingCommercialHypotheses.domainOwnership: Customer should remain owner of their domain; Joey may manage DNS/hosting for convenience.
workingCommercialHypotheses.acquisition: Prefer referrals, warm/local contacts, active-buyer platforms, genuine redesign conversations and legally compliant outreach over generic spam.

firstExternalTest.candidate: A friend with a real weightlifting-belt/product business may become a low-risk external product/commerce test if she wants it.
firstExternalTest.commercialFraming: A small contribution can cover direct generation costs while Joey treats the project primarily as a learning/test case, provided expectations and permission are clear.
learningGoals: Can a real product owner become genuinely happy with the result?
How much feedback and revision does a real customer require?
How much production time does the work really consume?
Can the same visual system produce useful web and motion/ad assets?
Does the finished work create real traction, trust or other measurable value?

clientFulfilmentSystem.principle: Use reusable coded masters plus customer config, real customer assets/proof, selected media and QA; do not rebuild everything from blank by default.

generationStrategy.paidCredits: Do not spend paid connector/image/video credits automatically.
priorityAssets: Agency hero Product-A-quality material/hero options that survive website use and zoom scrutiny.
Final hero + supporting visual set for Premium Plumbing with one consistent technician identity where people are used.
Distinct high-quality visual set for showcase 02.
Distinct high-quality visual set for showcase 03.
At least one genuinely usable product/ad motion direction for the secondary capability section.
generationStrategy.selectionRule: Generate enough variety to find winners, but curate aggressively. The target is a useful library, not a raw-generation count.
generationStrategy.resolutionRule: Judge assets at real website display size and use upscale/refinement only for selected winners when needed.
generationStrategy.historicalPlan: Previous Batch 5/6/7 Fire Challenger and joint-winner sequence is preserved as history but is no longer a mandatory gate.

integrationGate.rule: A generated or captured file is never live merely because it exists or was marked winner in local review state.
requiredSequence: Generate/import candidate to a known manifest path.
Set intended registry slot status to selected with a real committed selectedPath.
Let the Selected Assets loader populate the predefined slot.
Verify the actual Agency/flagship page on desktop and mobile.
integrationGate.failSafe: Missing/pending/failed selected media falls back to coded presentation rather than breaking the page.
